I really like this game. The Advanced mode is challenging and a lot of fun. However, as soon as I completed the mosaic, the levels started over and the difficulty dropped back down. title: Great game until higher levels
content:
The game is fun and addicting, I’ve completed multiple full branches of the adventure and have probably put in 50+ hours. 

The downside is, now I’m in areas where you need 2000-2100 points to pass the level. At this point, the game turns into AD slop otherwise winning is barely obtainable. As someone whose played games like this for several years at a high level - I’m no god but I trust then verify. After spending a complete day trying to beat these levels I ran it through AI step by step - unless your RNG is insanely perfect with blocks you receive, they rely on you watching minute long bloat ads to continue. 

They also will give you blocks that make no sense to your layout leaving you with certain failure. Any other game I’ve played in similarity, always has a win and gives you confusing blocks to make you think on placement and predictions of your next move, this game simply does not. 

Overall, good fun game but after a while you’ll have to rely on ads to beat certain levels.

author: Trump’s Tiny Hands
title: It’s ok
content:
I typically have enjoyed the game until it gets to the higher level rounds (specifically the adventure rounds that say only 1% can win), at which point it becomes literally impossible to win without watching multiple long ads, and even then, they’ll only give you two chances to continue this way and chances are it still wont be enough to win, so it can still take well over an hour to beat one level.  

I mean they will intentionally give you blocks that you can see immediately will not physically all fit, no matter how they are arranged.  Any other difficulty level is still doable, even if it takes severals tries.  It’s clear this is done so they can milk out as much ad revenue as possible from the ppl who want to complete the adventure puzzles.

The ads before these levels are bearable, bc theyre all short and aren’t too many.  But I will spend hours doing the same high level rounds like this to the point where the frustration with these levels alone has been enough for me to delete the app.  Mostly out of principle bc I hate when apps use these kind of impossible levels specifically to force you watch a ton of ads to make progress.  It’s just unnecessary, and I don’t need that kind of frustration in my life.  They’d have kept me as a user otherwise.  But that’s just me.
